name: Ezo Sunal
bio:
During her high school years, Ezo Sunal took part in theater and drama studies at the Royal Theater of North Hampton Guild Hall. She graduated from the University of Surrey Roehampton in 2006. After graduation, she worked as a magazine editor and organized various children’s workshops. She performed body percussion activities for deaf children. In 2013, she started to teach in the field of “Children and Dance” at Okan University.

In 2017, she founded the LALALA mobile application, which features original songs, stories, games, and activity ideas for preschool and primary school children, as well as a YouTube channel called LALALA World. She still works as an educator at the Ezo Sunal Children’s Workshop, which she founded, and prepares and runs training sessions for private institutions and gives presentations to organizations. Ezo Sunal also prepares content for the LALALA application, organizes concerts, and continues to write children’s books.
